Gru arrives to steal the show
Nobody suspected Judy was this dangerous

caption_styles: Keep it minimal: 1-2 words like 'Pure cinema' or 'Unreal'.
Use a single relevant emoji that matches the movie vibe.
Avoid long descriptions; let the on-screen hook do the work.
Include a call to action like 'Rate this 1-10' to boost engagement.
songs_to_add: Messages from the Stars - The Rah Band
avoid: Templated hooks or titles starting with 'The reason why...'.
Repeating '<Name>'s aura in this scene is unreal/terrifying' as a title formula.
Titles that paste the same hook on both sides of the pipe.
NCS-style instrumentals; prefer phonk, slowed-reverb, or mass beat-drop songs.
YouTube-only sources with no pre-downloaded official fallback (runners get bot-checked).
Long intros before the hook appears, or music sitting over the dialogue act.
top_channels: Aditya Movies - Masterclass in high-retention South Indian action cuts.
South Edit zone - Great use of trending audio for mass appeal.
1NLY EDITS - Excellent at VFX-heavy character showcases.
HAExEDITZ - Strong aesthetic consistency for Bollywood edits.
FDR Edit - Effective use of short, punchy evolution-style edits.
our_insights: The best pipeline Short since the last review is the Apothecary Diaries edit (Why Jinshi cannot stop watching her, Memory Reboot, 29s, 17:30 IST) with about 19k views.
Comedy character entrances also outperform generic action: Despicable Me / Gru with Goofy Ahh Phonk did about 4.3k; Jawan also did well.
24-29 second cuts are the sweet spot. Mid-pack videos using the 'aura in this scene' title formula stall around 1k views.
Afternoon and evening slots currently outperform early morning; 06:30 is solid but not the top slot.
Trailers without a pre-hosted official fallback fail on GitHub runners because YouTube bot-checks yt-dlp.
note: Updated 16 Nov 2026 growth review from own stats (Nov 15 snapshot) plus pipeline results; hook/title templates banned.
